create.name: Tracee Stanley
create.bio:
Tracee Stanley has practised yoga and tantra for close to thirty years, and since 2004 her teaching has centred on yoga nidra, meditation, sankalpa (heartfelt intention) and self-inquiry. She is a long-standing student of the Himalayan tradition and of Sri Vidya tantra, and she opened her first yoga studio in Los Angeles in 2001. A deep interest in spiritual ecology took her to Pacifica Graduate Institute for certificates in eco-therapy and ecopsychology, and the natural world, ritual and reverence for the ancestors run through much of what she offers.

She has written three books: Radiant Rest, a guide to yoga nidra; The Luminous Self, on yogic practice and ritual for remembering one's true nature; and Living Ritual, on weaving intention and the sacred into ordinary days. Most of her teaching happens online. She leads tantric meditation and yoga nidra teacher trainings, the second with Dr. Chanti Tacoronte-Perez, along with self-paced courses and a monthly membership offering dharma talks, full moon practice and seasonal rituals. She also runs occasional retreats in the American West and hosts the Radiant Rest podcast. Her five-day Commune course is a gentle introduction to yoga nidra as a conscious way of resting.

books.title: Radiant Rest: Yoga Nidra for Deep Relaxation and Awakened Clarity
books.author: Tracee Stanley
books.description: Her first book, a practical companion to yoga nidra rooted in the tantric and Himalayan teachings she studies. It sets out where the practice comes from and gives guided sessions for resting, setting a sankalpa and looking inward.

books.title: The Luminous Self: Sacred Yogic Practices and Rituals to Remember Who You Are
books.author: Tracee Stanley
books.description: A collection of meditations, rituals and self-inquiry drawn from tantra, offered as a way back to one's own inner light. It pays attention to the seasons, the ancestors and simple daily devotion.

books.title: Living Ritual: Infuse Each Day with Purpose and Spirit
books.author: Tracee Stanley
books.description: Her third book suggests small everyday rituals, larger ceremonies and reflective prompts for marking life's thresholds. It encourages readers to look up from their screens and reconnect with nature, their ancestors and one another.

courses.title: Deep Relaxation
courses.description: Five guided yoga nidra sessions, each with a handout and journaling prompts. The course moves gradually through the layers of the subtle body and the states of waking, dreaming and deep sleep, treating rest as a conscious practice.

courses.title: The Ritual of Mind Mapping
courses.description: A 21-day recorded course on mind mapping as a creative ritual. She shares the method behind her own projects, including her first book, and helps you shape a personal practice for clarity and purpose.

courses.title: Radiance Subscription
courses.description: Her monthly online membership. Each month brings a dharma talk with yoga nidra, a full moon meditation with mantra, guest workshops, seasonal rituals and a community space, with discounts on her other offerings.
courses.price: $18, $27 or $54 USD per month, or $299 USD per year (30-day free trial)

courses.title: Empowered Wisdom Yoga Nidra Teacher Training
courses.description: A 100-hour live online certification co-led with Dr. Chanti Tacoronte-Perez that treats yoga nidra as a state of awareness rather than a script to read. It covers the subtle body, sankalpa, ritual and mantra and how to guide others, finishing with an online embodiment retreat; places are by application.

courses.title: Pratyahara: The Art of Withdrawing Your Attention
courses.description: A two-day online workshop on pratyahara, the fifth limb of yoga, in which the senses are drawn inward. Through practice and discussion it looks at reclaiming attention from constant distraction and turning towards the true self.

courses.title: The Art of Honoring the Quiet Practices Retreat
courses.description: A week at Drala Mountain Center in Red Feather Lakes, Colorado, co-led with Caverly Morgan. Mornings begin in silence, and the days mix gentle movement, sitting practice and yoga nidra with unstructured time to write or make things.
